## What changes?

Describe the research, data, method, or documentation change.

## Evidence/provenance

- [ ] I linked the relevant source(s), case(s), or methodological rationale.
- [ ] Claim-level changes include a locator where applicable.
- [ ] I did not treat source count as independent replication count.

## Epistemic check

- [ ] I distinguished observation from interpretation/recommendation.
- [ ] I preserved important counterevidence and limitations.
- [ ] I did not silently promote `documented` to effective/corroborated.
- [ ] `unknown` values remain unknown rather than being filled by inference.

## Rights/privacy

- [ ] I did not add unnecessary personal/sensitive data.
- [ ] Third-party quotations/adaptations have appropriate provenance and rights treatment.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_corpus.py` passes.
